scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@smartgate/contracts && npm run build --workspace=@smartgate/permissions
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@smartgate/api && npm run build --workspace=@smartgate/control-web && npm run build --workspace=@smartgate/guard-web && npm run build --workspace=@smartgate/resident-web
scripts.migrate: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@smartgate/api && node --env-file-if-exists=.env scripts/migrate.mjs
scripts.setup:operator: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@smartgate/api && node --env-file-if-exists=.env scripts/bootstrap-operator.mjs
scripts.verify:postgres: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@smartgate/api && node --env-file-if-exists=.env scripts/postgres-verify.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@smartgate/api && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace=@smartgate/api
